adjudication_basis: Explicit stable issue_id survives title and lifecycle representation changes.
Append-only sequential Issue versions and history are executable.
Related Events, supporting/disputed Claims and differentiated Evidence references are executable.
Evidence categories and contradictions are represented, but complete qualification/corroboration semantics remain incomplete.
No complete executable Issue-level narrative versus empirical-condition qualification exists.
All five canonical trajectory dimensions are required and preserved separately.
Trajectory state, as-of time, evidence links, limitations and reviewer state are representable; trajectory inference is absent.
Source, Event, affected, policy and relevance geography remain separate.
Observability states and coverage profile reference are representable; coverage-derived observability determination remains absent.
Competent-authority candidates and review states are represented; full institutional-role mapping is incomplete.
Candidate authority is not exposed as established authority.
No canonical executable risk/opportunity representation exists in S1.4B.
No Issue-linked strategic-hypothesis object/runtime exists.
Watch-condition values may be stored but no executable watch-condition semantics or evaluator exists.
No executable significance-dimension representation/logic is implemented.
Issue Object exposes no universal confidence/priority/urgency score.
AR-01 through AR-09 are not represented or generated by S1.4B.
Review-required representation exists but no complete non-binding analytical-response/actionability runtime exists.
Contradictory evidence and uncertainty notes are explicit; full uncertainty qualification is not implemented.
Historical Issue state is reconstructable without later-recorded knowledge leakage.
Lineage fields persist, but authorized merge/split/correction execution is intentionally absent.
Production-excluded evidence can remain explicit; complete Issue-level rights/privacy aggregation is not implemented.
Review state is representable, but S1.4B deliberately grants no reviewer authority.
No complete decision-use metadata contract is executable in Issue Object.
No evidence-linked Issue Brief generator/runtime exists.
Serialization, version history and PIT reconstruction support reproducibility, but complete source/evidence/review replay is not yet integrated.
Stable explicit Issue identity now exists.
Canonical PC-01/PC-02/PC-03 vocabulary is executable in Issue Object.
Lifecycle state is represented, but lifecycle transition semantics are not executable.
Many-to-many-compatible explicit references exist, but relationship qualification remains human/external.
Predecessor/successor/merge/split lineage fields exist; transition authority is absent.
No executable recurrence/re-emergence classifier exists.
The ontology remains contracted but not executable at Issue qualification level.
Distinct geography dimensions are represented; complete relevance qualification remains outside this slice.
Persistent Issue Objects exist but are supplied explicitly rather than automatically constructed from upstream intelligence.
Explicit identity proposals can be checked for internal consistency; identity inference is absent.
No automatic Event-to-Issue clustering or Issue identity inference exists.
No runtime performs authorized Issue qualification/promotion.
Protected lifecycle and lineage transitions are not executed by S1.4B.
Event candidate, explicit Issue representation and storage exist as separate slices; no integrated construction workflow connects them yet.
